capabilities: Index Markdown tasks (- [ ] / - [x]) and planning date tokens across the vault
Filter, search, complete, edit, and reschedule tasks in a list view
Plan dated tasks and events in month, week, and day calendar views with drag-rescheduling
Read and optionally write back Apple Reminders and Apple Calendar data on macOS via a local helper
Sync Dida/TickTick tasks through the Open API and read public ICS calendars read-only
extras: Desktop-only (no mobile). Apple Reminders/Calendar integration requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later and uses a local helper; writeback to any external source is opt-in in settings. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian.
intentEvidence: Full Obsidian Tasks plugin grammar is not implemented.
motivation: The author built it so users don't need to move tasks into a separate task manager to see what is due and where it came from.
problem: Obsidian tasks are scattered across daily, meeting, and project notes with no unified place to review, filter, reschedule, or complete them alongside external task and calendar sources.

relations.evidence: Read Apple Reminders and Apple Calendar data on macOS through the local helper.
Apple Calendar events, Apple Reminders, public ICS feeds, and Dida/TickTick tasks
Sync Dida/TickTick tasks through the Open API when configured.

summary: Task workspace that indexes Markdown tasks from the vault alongside Apple Reminders, Apple Calendar, ICS feeds, and Dida/TickTick in list, calendar, and tag views.
